dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of multiple irregular, closed-loop light-colored structures with serrated high-contrast perimeters transitioning to lower-intensity darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, asymmetrical high-intensity light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the lower-left and posterior-right regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form a non-equilateral obtuse triangle, with smaller clusters forming a secondary curvilinear spatial relationship along the mid-lateral axis.
